faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: What services does Up-Brands provide?
items.answer: We provide three core services — brand strategy, creative visual design, and digital marketing — delivered bilingually in English and Chinese. This covers research and insights, strategic positioning, naming, visual identity, packaging, UI/UX, and campaign-ready content.

items.question: Do you handle both branding and marketing?
items.answer: Yes. We connect strategy, visual identity, packaging, and digital marketing so that your brand stays coherent from the first touchpoint to final conversion.

items.question: Can you take on a single deliverable, such as a logo or packaging?
items.answer: Yes. While we recommend a complete brand system, we also accept focused projects such as packaging design, a logo refresh, or a single campaign.

items.question: What does a typical project process look like?
items.answer: Requirement discussion, brand diagnosis, strategy proposal, creative execution, delivery and optimization, then ongoing support. Every stage is transparent and open to adjustment.

items.question: How long does a brand project take?
items.answer: Timelines depend on scope. A focused deliverable can be completed in a few weeks, while a full brand system usually spans six to twelve weeks from diagnosis to final delivery.

items.question: How do you work with clients remotely?
items.answer: We are based in Zhuhai and collaborate with clients across the Greater Bay Area and internationally through online meetings, shared documents, and bilingual deliverables.

items.question: How is pricing calculated?
items.answer: Pricing is tailored to project scope and complexity, typically ranging from tens of thousands to several hundred thousand RMB. We provide a transparent quote based on your specific needs.

items.question: Do you offer a free initial consultation?
items.answer: Yes. We offer a free preliminary brand diagnosis and a customized proposal before any commitment.

items.question: What are your payment terms?
items.answer: Projects are typically staged, starting with a deposit and followed by milestone-based payments, with the final balance due on delivery.

items.question: Where are you based, and which regions do you serve?
items.answer: We are rooted in Zhuhai and serve the Greater Bay Area — Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Zhuhai, Zhongshan, Foshan, Hong Kong, and Macau — as well as international clients remotely.

items.question: How do I start a project with Up-Brands?
items.answer: Reach out by email, phone, WhatsApp, or WeChat. We will schedule a discovery conversation and provide a free initial diagnosis.

items.question: Do you provide support after delivery?
items.answer: Yes. We offer post-delivery support and can continue with brand management, content, and marketing as your business grows.
